prompt: What was the military rank of the employer of the astronomer who discovered the globular cluster of stars called NGC 6441?
answer: NGC 6441 was discovered by **James Dunlop**, who worked at the Parramatta Observatory for **Sir Thomas Brisbane**. Brisbane was a **major general** in the British Army at the time. (He was later promoted to general.)
